difference_units: accuracy fraction; multiply by 100 for percentage points
interval_method: paired item percentile bootstrap via exact multinomial categories

bootstrap.method: percentile interval of with-replacement item resampling; paired -1/0/+1 counts are sufficient and may be resampled multinomially

harm_rule.definition: variant accuracy minus BF16 <= -0.02 and the upper endpoint of its paired 95% interval < 0

sample_limitations: Zero-shot standard harness prompts, without chat templates; not a chat evaluation.
ARC-Challenge uses its full test split; HellaSwag and MMLU use fixed 2,000-item samples, uniform and subject-stratified respectively, not their full test populations.
Intervals resample these items, not models, hardware, prompts or dataset selection.
No multiple-comparison correction; harm flags are not confirmatory population proof.
These multiple-choice results do not measure generation quality or perplexity.
Full-sequence quantization scales and key means can use later tokens; these are batch multiple-choice scores, not streaming-generation measurements.

runtime.scoring: native BF16 vocabulary projection; FP32 logsumexp; FP64 ordered token sum
runtime.batching: same exact sequence length, no padding, causal, no KV cache
runtime.elapsed_interpretation: sizing and cost only; not a latency benchmark

quantization.scales: independent Q/K/V amax/448 per batch and expanded head over full N,D
quantization.descale_shape: B,Hq after GQA expansion (API requires B,Hkv)
quantization.rounding: torch FP32-to-E4M3 cast after explicit [-448,448] clamp

accumulation.qk: E4M3 GMMA with float accumulator registers
accumulation.softmax: FP32 online recurrence, exp2 with max offset8
accumulation.pv: E4M3 unnormalized exp*256 and E4M3 V GMMA; float O registers rescaled across native tiles
accumulation.normalization: FP32 pre-E4M3-cast probability sum; V descale at finalize

adapter.smoothing: external K centering in FP64 before FP32; before optional shared FWHT; V untouched
adapter.hardware: Hopper sm90 only; D multiple16, D<=256
